tactics:
induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih => cases h : f a <;> simp_all [List.filterMap_cons, List.foldrM_cons]
induction l <;> simp_all [List.filterMap_cons, List.foldrM_cons] <;> split <;> simp_all

induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih => cases h : f a <;> simp [List.filterMap_cons, List.foldrM_cons, h, ih]

induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih => rw [List.filterMap_cons, List.foldrM_cons, ← ih]; cases f a <;> simp
